description: Contaminated sites database/historical landfills database is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Conservation and Parks. Local database that lists descriptions of contaminated sites and historic landfills in Guelph. This was created to ensure that staff in the regional offices/environmental officers have background information on the various sites. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Conservation and Parks. The portal shows 2023-06-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
